question: Which Article empowers the High Courts to issue writs for the enforcement of Legal and Fundamental Rights?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 226**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 226** of the Constitution of India empowers the **High Courts** to issue writs for the enforcement of **Legal and Fundamental Rights**.
 
• This Article provides the High Courts with jurisdiction to issue writs like **habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto, and certiorari**, for enforcing rights.
 
• The scope of Article 226 is broader than Article 32, as it allows High Courts to issue writs not only for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights but also for other legal rights. <span style="font-weight: bolder;&qu
